title: Studying Chinese Characters
synopsis: Here are some suggestions on how to remember Chinese characters. This is the Intermediate level winning text for our “Chinese Story” event, written by Vivian.

fullText.simplified:
学习汉字

    学中文的时候，我遇到各种各样的困难。当初，我上学校学中文，但是学校离我家很远，也越来越忙碌。最后我不能继续上课。所以我决定自己学习中文。
    我在我的手机里下载了许多应用，不过找到适合我的需要和水平的应用就比较难。我耗费了整整三天，用过很多很多应用才找到适合的。每天我都花15分钟至2小时使用那些应用学习中文。可是记住汉字很难，很多汉字看起来都一样，因此我很多次把一个字误认成了别的字。
    后来有一个朋友告诉我认字的方法。第一，我们可以看型识字。比如“龟”字，仔细地看它其实和一个乌龟非常相似。第二，分解识字。比如“富”字，一户家庭（宀）只有“一”个“口”吃饭，竟然有一块“田”，这户家庭当然有很多余粮，很“富”的。多亏了他，我才找到这些记住汉字的好方法。
fullText.traditional:
學習漢字

    學中文的時候，我遇到各種各樣的困難。當初，我上學校學中文，但是學校離我家很遠，也越來越忙碌。最後我不能繼續上課。所以我決定自己學習中文。
    我在我的手機裡下載了許多應用，不過找到適合我的需要和水平的應用就比較難。我耗費了整整三天，用過很多很多應用才找到適合的。每天我都花15分鐘至2小時使用那些應用學習中文。可是記住漢字很難，很多漢字看起來都一樣，因此我很多次把一個字誤認成了別的字。
    後來有一個朋友告訴我認字的方法。第一，我們可以看型識字。比如“龜”字，仔細地看它其實和一個烏龜非常相似。第二，分解識字。比如“富”字，一戶家庭（宀）只有“一”個“口”吃飯，竟然有一塊“田”，這戶家庭當然有很多餘糧，很“富”的。多虧了他，我才找到這些記住漢字的好方法。

raw.synopsis: Here are some suggestions on how to remember Chinese characters. This is the Intermediate level winning text for our “Chinese Story” event, written by Vivian.
sentence_translations: When learning Chinese, I ran into all sorts of difficulties.
At first, I went to school to study Chinese, but the school was very far from my home, and I was more and more busy.
In the end, I couldn’t continue attending class. So I decided to study Chinese on my own.
I downloaded a lot of apps on my phone, but finding an app that suited my needs and level was quite hard.
I wasted three whole days, and used many apps until I found suitable ones.
I spent 15 minutes to 2 hours every day studying Chinese using those apps.
But it’s very hard to remember Chinese characters. A lot of characters look the same.
As a result, many times I mistakenly recognized one character as another character.
Later, a friend told me about a method for recognizing characters.
Firstly, we can read characters by their shape.
For example, if you look carefully at the character for ”turtle”, it’s actually very similar to a turtle.
Secondly, breaking characters down and reading the parts.
The character ”wealthy” for example, a household (roof) that only has “one” “mouth” to feed, but actually has a “field”.
Of course, this household has a lot of surplus grain and is very “wealthy”.
Thanks to him, I finally found these good ways to remember Chinese characters.
